summary: Frontend-only critical regression retest executed on external preview. Added persistent Playwright spec tests/e2e/48-settings-refinement.spec.ts and ran targeted runs. Regression still reproduces: section targeting/selection breaks under scale + small screens, and security modal is cropped at 390x800 z150.

ui_bugs.issue: At scale matrix runs, selecting/clicking sections does not keep target in viewport; engine heading becomes offscreen (negative Y) while selected state can drift.
Selection desync observed: requesting journal results in selected='danger' and aria-current not on journal (1920x800 run).
At 390x800 and 150% scale, modal bottom is cropped (outside viewport).
Flow scale150 -> select ui -> reset does not preserve ui selection; select value reverts to engine.
On 320-width screenshots, footer action labels are visually wrapped/cropped (buttons split across lines) and long text clipping is visible.

integration_issues.issue: At 320x800 z150, selected value stayed 'privacy' instead of 'security' in test run.

issues: Primary footer buttons text wraps awkwardly and appears clipped
Dense text blocks appear cropped in section cards

action_items: Fix scroll target math/state sync so selected section and header coordinates remain inside settings-scroll viewport for scales 80/100/125/150 and all requested viewports.
Re-check scrollspy bottom override logic; it is overriding non-final targets (journal -> danger observed).
Fix security modal responsive height so dialog is fully visible at 390x800 with 150% scale.
Fix UI reset flow to preserve currently targeted UI section after reset and keep selector/nav state synchronized.
Tune 320-width settings footer/buttons and long-text wrapping to avoid clipped labels.
critical_code_review_comments: Regression still active despite prior 'fixed' claim: coordinate-based assertions fail with offscreen headings and selection desync.
State coupling between scroll position, select value, and aria-current is unstable under zoom/short viewport conditions.
Responsive modal sizing lacks guard for small viewport + high scale and can render outside visible area.
seed_data_creation: No destructive seed data created. Onboarding skip flag injected in browser localStorage for test contexts only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use APP_URL from /app/.env.local (external preview). Run: APP_URL=... APP_PASSWORD=... ADMIN_LOGIN=... npx playwright test tests/e2e/48-settings-refinement.spec.ts -g "settings navigation coordinates @ 1920x800" and -g "security modal open/cancel/focus/warnings". Repro is immediate with coordinate assertions (no toBeVisible-only checks).
rca of the issue: Repro: login admin -> skip onboarding -> open settings -> apply scale presets -> navigate sections via select/nav. Observed selected value and aria-current divergence, and target headings offscreen with negative top coordinates. This indicates scroll target computation/active section synchronization is still inconsistent under zoom and edge-of-scroll conditions. Additional responsive issue: security modal exceeds viewport bottom at 390x800 z150, indicating modal sizing/overflow constraints are incomplete.
